5.name: Operation Landsweep
5.description: Ever since a vagrant ruin drifted into the vicinity of the Diadem, the elemental balance of the isles has fallen into chaos. The land has undergone dramatic transformations, and we seek adventurers to conduct sweeping surveys and report on newly available resources. Mining, harvesting, fishing─gather the Diadem's bounty by whichever means you wish, and fear not that we will tax the riches you claim. We care only for the knowledge you uncover.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by gathering or participating in FATEs.
5.translation_description: Da quando una rovina errante è giunta nei pressi del Diadema, l'equilibrio elementale delle isole è precipitato nel caos. Il territorio ha subito trasformazioni radicali e cerchiamo avventurieri disposti a condurre ricognizioni a tappeto e a riferire sulle nuove risorse disponibili. Estrazione, raccolta, pesca: fai incetta dei tesori del Diadema come preferisci e non temere: non tasseremo ciò che raccoglierai. A noi interessa soltanto ciò che scoprirai.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempi la barra di valutazione della missione raccogliendo risorse o partecipando alle FATE.
5.col_2: Operation Command here.<hex:02100103>We have received your resources report and will add your findings to our ongoing appraisal.

5.translation_col_3: Per ritirare la ricompensa, recati al <hex:021A020203>Bounty<hex:021A020103>.
5.col_4: You are otherwise free to enter aetherial gaps, cross through the Grounding Gale, and explore the Diadem as you desire. The unknown awaits!
5.translation_col_4: Per il resto, sei libero di addentrarti nelle Fenditure Eteriche, attraversare la Raffica Ancorante ed esplorare il Diadema come preferisci. L'ignoto ti attende!

8.description: The dense aetherial concentration of the Diadem seems to attract the deadliest of creatures. Needless to say, these oft-hostile denizens significantly impede our efforts to explore the isles.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Thus we turn to you─to battle-hardened adventurers─to cull their numbers. 11.name: Operation Bloody Harvest
11.description: The Diadem is a world of its own, and the fantastical creatures found here are prime examples of the effects of prolonged isolation. Strange as they are, certain of these denizens have been rendered even stranger by the prevailing tempest of unstable aether...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>House Haillenarte naturalists are eager to examine the effects of elemental destabilization on the wildlife, and it falls to you to procure suitable samples for research. Make use of the traps provided, lure your prey, and obtain the requested specimens.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.

Usa le trappole fornite, attira le prede e raccogli gli esemplari richiesti.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il tuo successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerai.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempi la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

12.name: Operation Lethal Attraction
12.description: During our explorations throughout the Diadem, we have discovered that the scents emitted by certain species are effective in attracting many of the isles' predators. House Haillenarte's alchemists believe that they can mix these scents to concoct an all-purpose lure, and thus greatly improve the efficiency of our hunting parties. Track down two of the more potent-smelling examples, and harvest from them the substances our alchemists require.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
12.translation_description: Durante le nostre esplorazioni del Diadema, abbiamo scoperto che gli odori emessi da alcune specie attirano molti dei predatori delle isole. Gli alchimisti della Casata Haillenarte ritengono di poter mescolare questi odori per creare un'esca universale e rendere così molto più efficaci le nostre battute di caccia. Individua due specie dall'odore particolarmente intenso e raccogli da ciascuna le sostanze necessarie ai nostri alchimisti.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il tuo successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerai.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempi la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

13.name: Operation Egg Hunt
13.description: As part of House Haillenarte's ongoing naturalist research, we require an intrepid party to procure one of those fiendishly well-hidden dinosaur eggs. Rather than point you in a direction and hope for the best, however, our strategy relies upon the discerning appetite of the region's yolk mice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>We ask that you begin with the usual business of hunting the isles' denizens. But should the egg-devouring rodents surface, pray make haste to their location─the prize we seek cannot be far away. Slay the mice, secure the egg, then convey it to the designated collection point.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
13.translation_description: Nell'ambito delle ricerche naturalistiche della Casata Haillenarte, ci serve un gruppo di avventurieri audaci che recuperi un uovo di dinosauro così ben nascosto da essere quasi introvabile. Invece di indicarvi una direzione e sperare che basti, la nostra strategia si affida all'istinto dei Topi del Tuorlo della regione, roditori ghiotti di uova.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Vi chiediamo di iniziare cacciando le creature delle isole come al solito. Se dovessero comparire i Topi del Tuorlo, raggiungeteli in fretta: l'uovo che cerchiamo non può essere lontano. Abbattete i topi, recuperate l'uovo e portatelo al punto di raccolta designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.
13.col_2: That's far enough for a House Haillenarte agent to effect a safe retrieval.<hex:02100103>Nicely done!
13.translation_col_2: La consegna è sufficiente perché un agente della Casata Haillenarte possa recuperare l'uovo senza rischi.<hex:02100103>Ben fatto!

15.name: Operation Defang
15.description: The beasts of the Diadem pose the greatest obstacle to its exploration, and thus House Haillenarte has devised an alchemical solution. This enfeebling agent is designed to weaken the isles' denizens, but more experimentation is needed. Enter our adventurer allies! We will provide you with a supply of the elixir, as well as the targets upon which we wish the agent to be tested.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
15.translation_description: Le bestie del Diadema sono il principale ostacolo alle esplorazioni; per questo la Casata Haillenarte ha ideato una soluzione alchemica. Questa sostanza debilitante dovrebbe indebolire gli abitanti delle isole, ma occorrono altri esperimenti. Ed ecco che entrate in gioco voi, nostri alleati avventurieri! Vi forniremo una scorta dell'elisir e i bersagli sui quali vogliamo sperimentarlo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

22.description: During our explorations throughout the Diadem, we have discovered that the scents emitted by certain species are effective in attracting many of the isles' predators. 23.name: Operation Egg Hunt
23.description: As part of House Haillenarte's ongoing naturalist research, we require an intrepid party to procure one of those fiendishly well-hidden dinosaur eggs. Rather than point you in a direction and hope for the best, however, our strategy relies upon the discerning appetite of the region's yolk mice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>We ask that you begin with the usual business of hunting the isles' denizens. But should the egg-devouring rodents surface, pray make haste to their location─the prize we seek cannot be far away. Slay the mice, secure the egg, then convey it to the designated collection point.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
23.translation_description: Nell'ambito delle ricerche naturalistiche della Casata Haillenarte, ci serve un gruppo di avventurieri audaci che recuperi un uovo di dinosauro così ben nascosto da essere quasi introvabile. Invece di indicarvi una direzione e sperare che basti, la nostra strategia si affida all'istinto dei Topi del Tuorlo della regione, roditori ghiotti di uova.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Vi chiediamo di iniziare cacciando le creature delle isole come al solito. Se dovessero comparire i Topi del Tuorlo, raggiungeteli in fretta: l'uovo che cerchiamo non può essere lontano. Abbattete i topi, recuperate l'uovo e portatelo al punto di raccolta designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

51.name: Operation Bloody Harvest
51.description: The Diadem is a world of its own, and the fantastical creatures found here are prime examples of the effects of prolonged isolation. 52.name: Operation Lethal Attraction
52.description: During our explorations throughout the Diadem, we have discovered that the scents emitted by certain species are effective in attracting many of the isles' predators. House Haillenarte's alchemists believe that they can mix these scents to concoct an all-purpose lure, and thus greatly improve the efficiency of our hunting parties. Track down two of the more potent-smelling examples, and harvest from them the substances our alchemists require.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.

53.name: Operation Egg Hunt
53.description: As part of House Haillenarte's ongoing naturalist research, we require an intrepid party to procure one of those fiendishly well-hidden dinosaur eggs. Rather than point you in a direction and hope for the best, however, our strategy relies upon the discerning appetite of the region's yolk mice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>We ask that you begin with the usual business of hunting the isles' denizens. But should the egg-devouring rodents surface, pray make haste to their location─the prize we seek cannot be far away. Slay the mice, secure the egg, then convey it to the designated collection point.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.

Se dovessero comparire i Topi del Tuorlo, raggiungeteli in fretta: l'uovo che cerchiamo non può essere lontano. Abbattete i topi, recuperate l'uovo e portatelo al punto di raccolta designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

63.name: Operation Egg Hunt
63.description: As part of House Haillenarte's ongoing naturalist research, we require an intrepid party to procure one of those fiendishly well-hidden dinosaur eggs. But should the egg-devouring rodents surface, pray make haste to their location─the prize we seek cannot be far away. Abbattete i topi, recuperate l'uovo e portatelo al punto di raccolta designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

Rather than point you in a direction and hope for the best, however, our strategy relies upon the discerning appetite of the region's yolk mice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>We ask that you begin with the usual business of hunting the isles' denizens. But should the egg-devouring rodents surface, pray make haste to their location─the prize we seek cannot be far away. Slay the mice, secure the egg, then convey it to the designated collection point.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
74.translation_description: Nell'ambito delle ricerche naturalistiche della Casata Haillenarte, ci serve un gruppo di avventurieri audaci che recuperi un uovo di dinosauro così ben nascosto da essere quasi introvabile. Invece di indicarvi una direzione e sperare che basti, la nostra strategia si affida all'istinto dei Topi del Tuorlo della regione, roditori ghiotti di uova.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Vi chiediamo di iniziare cacciando le creature delle isole come al solito. Se dovessero comparire i Topi del Tuorlo, raggiungeteli in fretta: l'uovo che cerchiamo non può essere lontano. Abbattete i topi, recuperate l'uovo e portatelo al punto di raccolta designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.
74.col_2: That's far enough for a House Haillenarte agent to effect a safe retrieval.<hex:02100103>Nicely done!
74.translation_col_2: La consegna è sufficiente perché un agente della Casata Haillenarte possa recuperare l'uovo senza rischi.<hex:02100103>Ben fatto!
74.col_3: A fitting reward has been prepared in recognition of your efforts.
74.translation_col_3: Abbiamo preparato una ricompensa adeguata per riconoscere i tuoi sforzi.
74.col_4: You are otherwise free to enter aetherial gaps, cross through the Grounding Gale, and explore the Diadem as you desire. The unknown awaits!
74.translation_col_4: Per il resto, sei libero di addentrarti nelle Fenditure Eteriche, attraversare la Raffica Ancorante ed esplorare il Diadema come preferisci. L'ignoto ti attende!

75.name: Operation Defang
75.description: The beasts of the Diadem pose the greatest obstacle to its exploration, and thus House Haillenarte has devised an alchemical solution. This enfeebling agent is designed to weaken the isles' denizens, but more experimentation is needed. Enter our adventurer allies! We will provide you with a supply of the elixir, as well as the targets upon which we wish the agent to be tested.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
75.translation_description: Le bestie del Diadema sono il principale ostacolo alle esplorazioni; per questo la Casata Haillenarte ha ideato una soluzione alchemica. Questa sostanza debilitante dovrebbe indebolire gli abitanti delle isole, ma occorrono altri esperimenti. Ed ecco che entrate in gioco voi, nostri alleati avventurieri! 81.name: Operation Bloody Harvest
81.description: The Diadem is a world of its own, and the fantastical creatures found here are prime examples of the effects of prolonged isolation. Strange as they are, certain of these denizens have been rendered even stranger by the prevailing tempest of unstable aether...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>House Haillenarte naturalists are eager to examine the effects of elemental destabilization on the wildlife, and it falls to you to procure suitable samples for research. Make use of the traps provided, lure your prey, and obtain the requested specimens.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.

82.name: Operation Lethal Attraction
82.description: During our explorations throughout the Diadem, we have discovered that the scents emitted by certain species are effective in attracting many of the isles' predators. House Haillenarte's alchemists believe that they can mix these scents to concoct an all-purpose lure, and thus greatly improve the efficiency of our hunting parties. Track down two of the more potent-smelling examples, and harvest from them the substances our alchemists require.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.

91.name: Operation Bloody Harvest
91.description: The Diadem is a world of its own, and the fantastical creatures found here are prime examples of the effects of prolonged isolation. Strange as they are, certain of these denizens have been rendered even stranger by the prevailing tempest of unstable aether...<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>House Haillenarte naturalists are eager to examine the effects of elemental destabilization on the wildlife, and it falls to you to procure suitable samples for research. Make use of the traps provided, lure your prey, and obtain the requested specimens.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.

92.name: Operation Lethal Attraction
92.description: During our explorations throughout the Diadem, we have discovered that the scents emitted by certain species are effective in attracting many of the isles' predators. House Haillenarte's alchemists believe that they can mix these scents to concoct an all-purpose lure, and thus greatly improve the efficiency of our hunting parties. Track down two of the more potent-smelling examples, and harvest from them the substances our alchemists require.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
92.translation_description: Durante le nostre esplorazioni del Diadema, abbiamo scoperto che gli odori emessi da alcune specie attirano molti dei predatori delle isole. Individua due specie dall'odore particolarmente intenso e raccogli da ciascuna le sostanze necessarie ai nostri alchimisti.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il tuo successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerai.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempi la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

93.name: Operation Egg Hunt
93.description: As part of House Haillenarte's ongoing naturalist research, we require an intrepid party to procure one of those fiendishly well-hidden dinosaur eggs. Rather than point you in a direction and hope for the best, however, our strategy relies upon the discerning appetite of the region's yolk mice.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>We ask that you begin with the usual business of hunting the isles' denizens. But should the egg-devouring rodents surface, pray make haste to their location─the prize we seek cannot be far away. Slay the mice, secure the egg, then convey it to the designated collection point.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
93.translation_description: Nell'ambito delle ricerche naturalistiche della Casata Haillenarte, ci serve un gruppo di avventurieri audaci che recuperi un uovo di dinosauro così ben nascosto da essere quasi introvabile. Invece di indicarvi una direzione e sperare che basti, la nostra strategia si affida all'istinto dei Topi del Tuorlo della regione, roditori ghiotti di uova.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Vi chiediamo di iniziare cacciando le creature delle isole come al solito. Se dovessero comparire i Topi del Tuorlo, raggiungeteli in fretta: l'uovo che cerchiamo non può essere lontano. Abbattete i topi, recuperate l'uovo e portatelo al punto di raccolta designato.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.

95.name: Operation Defang
95.description: The beasts of the Diadem pose the greatest obstacle to its exploration, and thus House Haillenarte has devised an alchemical solution. This enfeebling agent is designed to weaken the isles' denizens, but more experimentation is needed. Enter our adventurer allies! We will provide you with a supply of the elixir, as well as the targets upon which we wish the agent to be tested.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Evaluation of your success will also hinge upon the extent of your explorations.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Fill the evaluation gauge by participating in FATEs.
95.translation_description: Le bestie del Diadema sono il principale ostacolo alle esplorazioni; per questo la Casata Haillenarte ha ideato una soluzione alchemica. Questa sostanza debilitante dovrebbe indebolire gli abitanti delle isole, ma occorrono altri esperimenti. Ed ecco che entrate in gioco voi, nostri alleati avventurieri! Vi forniremo una scorta dell'elisir e i bersagli sui quali vogliamo sperimentarlo.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>Il vostro successo sarà valutato anche in base a quanto esplorerete.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Riempite la barra di valutazione della missione partecipando alle FATE.
